summary: Blue Moon Metals filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive share purchase agreement to sell 100% of Blue Moon Norway AS—holder of the construction-stage Nussir copper mine and exploration-stage NSG property—to LSE-listed ACG Metals in an all-share transaction valued at US$220 million. Consideration is ACG Class A Ordinary Shares issued at an implied 18.70 per share based on the 30-day VWAP. ACG characterized the approach as unsolicited. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. Blue Moon shareholders gain exposure to ACG's cash-flowing copper mines while refocusing on four U.S. critical metals assets. Watch closing conditions, ACG share price performance, and whether the equity consideration holds value through the regulatory clock.
